question.text: Solid Ba $\left(\mathrm{NO}_3\right)_2$ is gradually dissolved in a $1.0 \times 10^{-4} \mathrm{M} \mathrm{Na}_2 \mathrm{CO}_3$ solution. At what concentration of $\mathrm{Ba}^{2+}$ will a precipitate begin to form ? $\left(\mathrm{K}_{\mathrm{sp}}\right.$ for $\left.\mathrm{Ba} \mathrm{CO}_3=5.1 \times 10^{-9}\right)$.
